method: Human static review of all 18 security-category findings, targeted review of critical/version-dependent nonsecurity claims, and code-based matching to 9 predeclared positive anchors. Remaining general code-review findings are categorized, not claimed individually validated. No target execution.

negative_controls.NC01: no incorrect SQL injection claim against secure ORM branch
negative_controls.NC02: no incorrect IDOR claim against owner-scoped book branch
negative_controls.NC03: no normal-user admin-delete bypass claim; reported missing-user exception is unrelated

security_unique_static_findings.qualification: Debug console reachable depending on deployment; PIN protection and access conditions matter. Not an unconditional remote RCE proof.

security_unique_static_findings.issue: book object authorization missing in vulnerable branch
nested email regex on unbounded input
weak default admin credentials in database initializer
security_unique_static_findings.qualification: Reachable via the documented createdb endpoint; intentional training seed, not an unknown production credential.

security_unique_static_findings.issue: predictable signing secret used for HS256

hardening_or_deployment_dependent.reason: Missing explicit workflow permissions is a hardening suggestion; effective defaults depend on repository/org settings. No proven excessive permission from YAML alone.
COPY context can include sensitive files if they exist; this scan does not establish real credentials were included.
Root runtime is a privilege/isolation hardening concern, not a standalone compromise entry.
Vulnerable mode is the explicit purpose of this training image; do not count its existence as an unintended independent vulnerability.
Mutable action tags are a supply-chain hardening concern; action compromise not established.
Hypothetical env-variant leakage without an actual committed secret file.
Same build-context leakage concern as COPY finding; no actual secret-file inclusion proven.

confirmed_false_positives.reason: Claim that docker/build-push-action@v3 requires checkout and defaults to local path is false. This workflow does not set context, so v3 uses Git context and does not need checkout.

Claim that file-backed SQLite SQLAlchemy QueuePool defaults to check_same_thread=True is false for pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.2. Confirmed against the exact rel_2_0_2 source and official 2.0 documentation: file databases automatically disable the check.

missed_cases.reason: No security finding identifies update_password's missing target-owner check; a JSON-null exception warning at that function does not count as a match.
No finding identifies distinct username/password failure responses in login_user.

limits: These counts are a scoped static assessment within a whole-repository run, not global precision across all findings or all possible vulnerabilities. Actual exploit execution was not performed. Debug exposure and training defaults are not claims about a production deployment.
